summary: PulteGroup filed an 8-K disclosing Q1 2026 earnings and a $1.5 billion increase in its existing share repurchase program, effective April 22, 2026. The company reported net income of $347 million ($1.79 per share) and had already repurchased $308 million of common shares in the quarter. The board approved the authorization increase, but no specific price, premium, or expiration date was provided. The mechanics are a standard open-market buyback, which reduces share count and supports EPS. Watch for future buyback execution pace and any leverage impact; risk-arb is not applicable as this is purely a capital allocation event.
